g.text: For spans and choices, scoring beats generating: +6.7 / +10.8 mIoU over the backbones,
+1.3 over autoregressive fine-tuning on the same data.
Joint inference: ten questions cost almost the same as one (+55 ms grounding, +31 ms QA).
Video QA within 0.6 points of, or above, Thinking mode, at about 1/100 of the time.
Soft IoU is worth +4.6 mIoU; training grounding and QA together helps both tasks (+0.7 / +1.3).
5 · Confidence is a bonus, not yet reliable
High confidence predicts correctness, but the probabilities are overconfident (ECE ≈ 8 points).
